dialog.time_dawn: Dawn loops are usually stable. Mark your path or the street will rearrange you.

dialog.time_dusk: Dusk is paradox weather. If a clock runs backward, leave it alone.
dialog.time_night: Night splits voices from bodies. Use call-and-response to track your team.
